tools.name: get_layers_agent_endpoints
tools.description: Get the public Layers endpoints an agent needs: MCP servers, OAuth discovery documents, auth.md and the agent skills index.

tools.name: list_layers_pages
tools.description: List the main pages of the Layers marketing site (products, integrations, customers, developers, blog, changelog, FAQ) with their URLs.

tools.name: navigate_layers_site
tools.description: Navigate this browser tab to a page on the Layers marketing site. Accepts a site-relative path such as /products/search or /integrations/klaviyo.

path.description: Site-relative path beginning with a forward slash, for example /faq.

tools.name: search_layers_articles
tools.description: Search Layers blog articles by title, description or tag. Returns titles, dates and page URLs.

query.description: Text to match against article titles and summaries.

tools.name: search_layers_integrations
tools.description: Search the apps and platforms Layers integrates with. Returns the integration name, category, summary and page URL.

query.description: Optional text to match against the integration name, category or summary.
